name: Chemist's Emergency
description: A field chemist urgently needs rare reagents.|The settlement depends on emergency compounds, but critical ingredients are depleted. Recover reagents from the marsh zone.

text: My reagent stock is empty and patients are lining up.
Bring me 3 Blue Lilies from the marsh.
I'd go myself, but I don't survive outside lab walls.
completedText: The settlement is waiting on these compounds.

hasItemText: Great quality. But we still need stabilizers.
Bring 2 paprikas and 2 tomatoes for compound balancing.
This is the final supply run.
completedText: Please bring back 2 paprikas and 2 tomatoes.

hasItemText: You did it. Production is back online.
Take this combat stimulant as payment.

popup.title: Quest completed!
popup.text: @green@You have just finished @crimson@Chemist's Emergency@green@. You've been awarded a @crimson@Hot Sauce@green@ and @crimson@1500@green@ Foraging experience!
